# Pose fixtures (slice S4)

Generated by `node tests/fixtures/poses/generate.mjs`, except the two hand-written text files noted below.
Landmarks are computed with the independent forward kinematics in `tests/helpers/poses.mjs`, never with `retarget.js`.
All fixtures use a zero root translation and identity root rotation.

| File | Purpose | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| `valid-minimal.json` | one joint (`left_elbow`), no overlay hash or notes | `validatePose` ok; `checkLeftRight` consistent |
| `valid-full.json` | all 23 non-root joints, notes, overlay hash | ok; consistent |
| `valid-crossed-hands.json` | mirror-symmetric arms, wrists meet at the midline | ok; wrist pair `inconclusive`, ankle pair `consistent` |
| `invalid-mirrored.json` | asymmetric pose (left arm raised, right leg stepped) with left/right rotations swapped | schema-valid; `checkLeftRight` → `E_LEFT_RIGHT` on the ankles |
| `invalid-E_*.json` | `valid-full` with one fault, named by the first error code | `errors[0].code` equals the file's code |
| `invalid-E_MISSING-landmark.json` | `landmarks.right_ankle` removed | `E_MISSING` |
| `invalid-E_JSON.json` | plain text, hand-written | `E_JSON` |
| `invalid-proto-pollution.json` | raw text with an own `"__proto__"` key, hand-written | `E_UNKNOWN_KEY`, nothing polluted |

`E_SIZE` has no fixture: the test builds a > 64 KiB string at run time.

## Contract the tests assume where the spec is silent

- `rest` is `Map<name, {local, world, position}>` of plain arrays (`[x, y, z, w]` for quaternions).
- `validatePose(input, {origin})` → `{ok:true, pose}` or `{ok:false, errors:[{code, path, message}]}`; `path` is a dotted string naming the key;
  `errors[0]` is the first fault; `input` may be a string (size-checked in UTF-8 bytes) or a value.
- `checkLeftRight(rest, pose)` → `{ok, errors:[{code:'E_LEFT_RIGHT', path, message}], pairs:{wrist, ankle}}` with each pair `'consistent' | 'inconclusive' | 'swapped'`.
- `applyPose(rest, pose)` → `{locals: Map(24), rootTranslation}`; `rootTranslation` is the file's offset, which `forwardKinematics` adds to the pelvis rest position.
